note: 20-query pilot across two deliberately contrasting categories. general_facts is the baseline where every vendor should score well; code_technical is where docs/04 predicts freshness and version drift separate them most. If spread appears anywhere, it appears here first — which is what makes this pair the cheapest possible test of the routing thesis. Full runs seed general_facts from real SimpleQA (MIT); these pilot items are hand-authored in that style to keep the pilot free of any dataset-license question.

queries.text: Who wrote the novel Things Fall Apart and in what year was it published?
What is the deepest point in the ocean and how deep is it?
queries.gold_answer: Challenger Deep, Mariana Trench, approximately 10,935 metres

queries.text: Which element has the atomic number 79?
Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize and in which category?
What year did the Chernobyl nuclear disaster occur?
What is the capital city of Kazakhstan and what was it previously called?
Who directed the film Seven Samurai?
What is the longest river in South America?
In what year was the Treaty of Westphalia signed?
Who invented the World Wide Web and at which organisation?
How do I use the use() hook in React 19 to read a promise inside a component?
queries.gold_answer: use() unwraps a promise or context during render; must be called with a stable/cached promise, works with Suspense boundaries.

queries.text: What replaced the deprecated datetime.utcnow() in Python 3.12 and how do I write timezone-aware UTC timestamps?
How do I configure strict mode for tool definitions in the Anthropic Python SDK?
queries.gold_answer: Set strict: true as a top-level field on the tool definition, with additionalProperties: false and required in the input schema.

queries.text: In Next.js 15 App Router, how do I opt a route out of static rendering?
queries.gold_answer: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic', or use runtime APIs like cookies()/headers().

queries.text: How do I define a partial unique index in PostgreSQL 16?
queries.gold_answer: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ... ON table (col) WHERE condition;

queries.text: What is the difference between uv pip install and uv add in the uv package manager?
queries.gold_answer: uv pip install is the pip-compatible interface; uv add edits pyproject.toml and updates the lockfile in a uv-managed project.

queries.text: How do I enable strict null checks incrementally in an existing TypeScript 5 codebase?
queries.gold_answer: strictNullChecks in tsconfig, typically scoped via separate configs, project references, or per-file // @ts-check migration.

queries.text: How do I set a per-request timeout in httpx for Python and what are the four timeout components?
queries.gold_answer: httpx.Timeout(connect=, read=, write=, pool=) passed as timeout= per request or on the client.

queries.text: In Rust, what changed about async closures in the 2024 edition?
queries.gold_answer: Async closures (async || {}) were stabilised, with AsyncFn/AsyncFnMut/AsyncFnOnce traits.

queries.text: How do I run a matrix build across multiple Python versions in GitHub Actions and fail fast on the first error?
queries.gold_answer: strategy.matrix with python-version list; fail-fast: true is the default, set false to run all.
